blurb: Altitude Gym Kanata is the biggest bouldering gym in North America with over 12,000 square feet of bouldering walls and more than 250 bouldering problems. The gym offers bouldering, top-rope climbing with auto-belays, a speed wall, a Ninja Warrior obstacle course, and an augmented climbing wall. They provide climbing shoe rentals and require clean indoor shoes for Ninja Warrior and climbing shoes for climbing.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to secure birthday party reservation · Refunds for birthday parties only if cancelled at least 1 week prior · Month-to-month memberships can be cancelled anytime without penalty with notice before the 10th of the month
